test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given chart based on the population using different types of transport in the given cities. Assuming that no person uses more than one type of transport, answer the question that follows. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/406169bfd21e5b2a92f0bade64fe4cf6dd7d0f1c4938ed648d579ba4526b49ae.png] 

What is the percentage of people using all types of transportation in Pune to the total number of people using all types of transportation in all cities?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The people using all types of transportation in Pune

⇒ 4 + 3 + 2 

⇒ 9

The total number of people using all types of transportation in all cities

⇒ (Pune + Nasik + Nagpur + Mumbai)

⇒ (9 + 9 + 8.5 + 12.5)

⇒ 39

The percentage of people using all types of transportation in Pune to the total number of people using all types of transportation in all cities

⇒ (9/39)× 100

⇒ 23.08%

**∴ The percentage of people using all types of transportation in Pune to the total 
number of people using all types of transportation in all cities is 23.08%.**
